title: What a matches case binds
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
"2024-03-05" match { case m matches /\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/ -> m else -> null }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
"2024-03-05" match { case m matches /\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/ -> m else -> null }

explanation.approach: An Array: the whole match, then any groups. Keep a separate name for the text itself.
